C0441.title: Global Credit Card Fraud Losses Continue to Climb
C0441.summary: Card cracking fraud has driven global losses from approximately $18 billion in 2014 to over $32 billion in 2022. Attackers purchase leaked card number lists from darknet markets and use automated tools to brute-force expiration dates and CVV security codes in order to obtain valid payment card credentials.
